newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-EXPOS' SEGUI SUSPENDED ONE GAME FOR CHARGING MOUND.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-EXPOS' SEGUI SUSPENDED ONE GAME FOR CHARGING MOUND.

text.p: The National League suspended Montreal Expos first baseman David Segui for one game and fined him an undisclosed amount Wednesday for charging the mound last Saturday during a game against the Florida Marlins.
Segui, who is batting .330 with six homers and 30 RBI this season, is appealing the suspension. He was batting cleanup and playing first base Wednesday night against the Toronto Blue Jays.

Segui attempted to charge Florida pitcher Livan Hernandez after being hit by a pitch in the fourth inning, but was restrained by catcher Charles Johnson. The bench-clearing incident came one inning after Montreal pitcher Jim Bullinger hit Marlins slugger Gary Sheffield with a pitch.

"I knew they were going to hit somebody," Segui said after the game. "So if they're going to protect their players and be tough guys, here we go ... I'm not a believer in charging the mound. Usually you don't get there anyway, but I got tossed and the coward got away."
Hernandez remained in the game and worked five innings for his first major league victory as the Marlins defeated the Expos 4-2.
